exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: apps.initial_support: retain candidates appearing in the top 10 apps of at least 20% of participants (n=17)

inputBoundary: An already-derived unique-participant support count for one candidate app among source-aligned per-participant top-10 app lists, plus the complete participant denominator.
outputBoundary: Retain the candidate when support is at least 20% of 84 participants: the integer threshold is ceil(16.8) = 17, and equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not derive application-use events or participant identities.
This binding does not normalize or rank app frequency and duration within each participant.
This binding does not construct each participant's top-10 app membership list or deduplicate participant support.
This binding does not reproduce the manual 5-percentage-point support-threshold search.
This binding does not rank retained candidates or select the final top five apps.
A missing support count or participant denominator, a zero denominator, or support greater than the denominator fails closed.
